title: TIMELINE: Mary Jane Veloso's decade-long ordeal from Indonesian death row to absolute pardon
summary: Mary Jane Veloso was arrested in Indonesia when she was 25. She turns 40 next month, and hopes for a clemency to start a new life back in Philippines.
